author: Ubisoft
description:
The next chapter of The Division 2 starts now.
Year 8 kicks off in April with Season 1: Rise Up, calling Agents to unite against the Black Tusk. This new season brings revamped gear, weapons, and new features designed to raise the challenge and your power as an agent.
But Rise Up is only the beginning.
Throughout Year 8, Agents can expect major updates and long-requested features rolling out across future seasons, including:
• PvP-focused balancing updates and new content
• Cross Play across platforms
• The return of Classified Assignments with new story-driven missions
• A brand-new Incursion
• Survivors — the return of winter survival to the franchise
• And an all-new DLC coming later this year
This anniversary year is packed with content, challenges, and new ways to play.
It’s never been a better time to be an Agent.
title: The Division 2 | The Road Ahead

title: The Division 2 | New DLC Teaser

author: Ubisoft
description:
The Division turns 10 and there has never been a better time to join!
To mark a decade of The Division, we’re launching a special four-week Anniversary Season in The Division 2, with new activities and rewards rolling out each week.
Agents can take on two brand-new Global Events inspired by the original game, earn the return of the iconic Exotic LMG Big Alejandro on the free rewards track, and unlock tactical uniforms from across the Tom Clancy universe through the Anniversary Pass.
We’re also introducing a limited-time Realism Mode, delivering a more intense and unforgiving way to experience the game. In addition, Warlords of New York is free to play for all players during the Anniversary.
Alongside the celebration comes a major visual upgrade and exclusive anniversary rewards for all players.
Jump in and celebrate 10 years of The Division.
title: The Division 2 | Anniversary Season

author: Ubisoft
description:
Get ready for the biggest shake-up yet with The Crew Motorfest Season 9!

About The Crew Motorfest:
Welcome to Motorfest! Discover the evergreen festival featuring the best experiences car culture has to offer. Complete your ultimate action driving bucket list through a series of tailor-made races, themed events, and other unique challenges. Explore the vibrant island of O’ahu in Hawaii alone or with your crew. Whatever the way you enjoy cars and driving, there is something in there for you!
